title: Runtime Data-at-Rest Encryption + SafeFilePath Hardening
problem: After Cycle 9, Hotkey analytics JSON was still plaintext on disk and dropped chat images were persisted without SafeFilePath validation or encryption. ConversationEncryption was a hard-coded singleton with no reusable helper, and clade-audit's build gate used an incomplete swiftc -typecheck that missed the QueenUILib dependency and untracked BR-OUTPUT prototypes.
root_cause: No shared AES-256-GCM primitive existed for runtime stores. HotkeyAnalytics flushed usage_*.json plaintext. ChatAttachmentImporter wrote directly to Application Support without validating the destination. The audit scanner treated E2E 'error:' logs as build failures and did not skip .worktrees or honor AGENT-V-WAIVER markers.
fix: Created TriOSEncryption helper with named per-purpose keys in Application Support/trios/keys. Refactored ConversationEncryption to delegate to it while preserving the legacy conversation.key location. Encrypted HotkeyAnalytics flush/load with legacy plaintext migration. Added SafeFilePath validation and 0o700 + excluded-from-backup directory setup to ChatAttachmentImporter. Hardened clade-audit to run ./build.sh, skip .worktrees/.build/target/.git, and honor AGENT-V-WAIVER markers. Added TriOSEncryptionTests, ConversationEncryptionTests, ChatAttachmentImporterSafePathTests, and HotkeyAnalyticsEncryptionTests.

variants.name: A - minimal encryption coverage
variants.summary: Use TriOSEncryption only for ConversationPersister and HotkeyAnalytics; skip attachment SafeFilePath and encryption. Fast but leaves dropped-image weak spot open.

variants.name: B - balanced runtime encryption + SafeFilePath
variants.summary: Shared encryption helper, encrypted analytics with legacy migration, SafeFilePath validation for attachments, and an encrypted-attachment marker for Cycle 11. Shipped and passes all gates.

variants.name: C - comprehensive runtime encryption
variants.summary: Also encrypt MemoryStore SQLite, encrypt attachment images end-to-end, and add an audit log for every agent file write. Strongest privacy bar but requires SQLCipher and a cross-stack attachment refactor; deferred beyond one cycle.
